the fact that blood homocysteine is higher in people with the 677 TT isoform than in those with the 677 CC isoform, but only
when overall folate and riboﬂavin status is low. When overall folate and riboﬂavin status is high, no difference in homocysteine
is observed between the isoforms.
The clinical and public health importance of the MTHFR polymorphism is reﬂected by two observations: First, women with the
677 TT isoform are at increased risk of having a child with a neural tube defect (e.g., spina biﬁda and anenencephaly) (Reilly et al.,
2014). This risk can be reduced by folic acid supplements, an observation that underlies the decision by the US and Canadian
governments to mandate folic acid fortiﬁcation of grain products in 1998 (Miller, 2011). This program has been highly successful,
having reduced the prevalence of folate deﬁciency from over 20% to approximately 1%, the prevalence of hyperhomocysteinemia
by approximately 50%, and the incidence of neural tube defects by at least 20%. The success of the folic acid fortiﬁcation program in
the USA and Canada has spawned similar programs in more than 80 countries and territories throughout the world. Notable excep-
